notes: Main original article routes returned unavailable/404; original statistics are independently available in its published primary Appendix E, whose title and DOI match the supplied reference. Original analytic n is not printed in that appendix and was not derived from degrees of freedom or substituted from the replication report. The supplied original p. 6 locator could not be directly checked; Appendix E explicitly describes the main-article planning-mix analysis. Selected omnibus interaction consistently across both sides; original linear contrast also printed F(1, 99) = 7.54, p = .007; corresponding replication linear contrast F(1, 297) = 1.44, p = .23. The replication reference is dated 2019, but its explicit URL identifies the November 2022 replication, which was extracted rather than the archived earlier attempt. Replication additional-specification analysis is distinct from the selected full-sample analysis. Authors describe nonsignificant replication results but do not give an explicit categorical replication-success verdict in this report; reported_success left null rather than inferred from significance.
